learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: What HRV is, why we show it the way we do, and what the number means for you.

what.heading: What is HRV?
what.body: Heart-rate variability is the small variation in time between your heartbeats. It reflects your autonomic nervous system: the balance between accelerator and brake. It is not a diagnosis, but a pointer to how recovered your body is.

rmssd.heading: Why RMSSD?
rmssd.body: There are many HRV numbers; we show RMSSD because it is the most robust for short, daily readings. We show you your actual value in milliseconds, not an invented “score”.

noScore.heading: Why you don't get a 0-100 score
noScore.body: A number from 0 to 100 promises a precision that does not exist. We show your real number and your own baseline band, so you see where you sit relative to your own normal.

noCompare.heading: Why you can't compare your HRV with others'
noCompare.body: Healthy RMSSD ranges from about 10 to 200 ms depending on age, sex and fitness. A high number for one person is a low number for another. Only your own baseline matters.

cycle.heading: Cycle & HRV
cycle.body: For female members: HRV naturally swings across the menstrual cycle, typically lower in the days before menstruation. Turn on cycle tracking under Settings so your baseline accounts for it.

page.title: HRV
page.subtitle: Your heart-rate variability: a daily read on how ready your body is to train.
page.connectTitle: Let HRV run in the background.
page.connectBody: HRV (heart-rate variability) tells how recovered you are. Connect a wearable and MakeIt syncs your HRV every morning. No manual reading, no extra routine. It is just there when you wake up.
page.connectStep1Body: One tap. You approve access with your wearable provider.
page.connectStep2Body: MakeIt fetches last night's reading automatically. You do nothing.
page.connectStep3Body: The first couple of weeks MakeIt learns your normal. Then you see your HRV readiness.
page.connectAppleNote: Apple Watch support arrives with the MakeIt iPhone app.

learnAdaptive.title: How the engine thinks
learnAdaptive.subtitle: See the full decision chain behind a daily session adjustment, and try changing the signals yourself.

hero.p1: The adaptive engine adjusts today's session from four things: your HRV reading, your sleep, last session's RPE, and your latest form checks. It fires every morning at 05:30, and you see the result when you open the session.
hero.p2: We show you the whole line of thought. What the engine saw, which rule fired, and what Munk's AI assistant may have adjusted. You can also pull on a signal and see what the engine would have chosen instead.

playground.body: Drag a slider and watch the engine's decision change live. It all runs in your browser: no API calls, no spinner wait. That works because the engine is a pure function.

bounds.title: What may the engine do?
engine: Suggest a lighter variant of the main lift
bounds.footer: And no matter what: you can always say “keep original” in the session and run the planned program. Nothing happens behind your back. Every decision is logged and can be inspected.
